quotes.label: contradicts
quotes.quote: The conducted meta-analyses indicated that beta-carotene supplementation had no protective effect against lung cancer development.
quotes.reason: It reports that beta-carotene had no protective effect and may increase lung cancer risk in some groups.

quotes.label: contradicts
quotes.quote: A meta-analysis conducted by Druesne-Pecollo et al. [12] also indicated an increased risk of lung cancer in trials where the daily dose of beta-carotene supplementation was ≥20 mg (RR = 1.16, 95% CI = 1.06–1.27) vs. lower doses (RR = 0.93, 95% CI = 0.69–1.25).
quotes.reason: It reports increased lung cancer risk with higher beta-carotene doses, against the protective claim.

quotes.label: contradicts
quotes.quote: Beta-carotene supplementation clearly has a negative effect on the risk of lung cancer in smokers and asbestos workers.
quotes.reason: It states beta-carotene has a negative effect on lung cancer risk in smokers, opposite to the claimed protection.

quotes.label: contradicts
quotes.quote: The large Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial (CARET), however, found significant increases in lung cancer incidence from combined treatment with retinyl palmitate and beta carotene when administered in high risk populations.
quotes.reason: CARET found beta carotene combined with retinyl palmitate increased lung cancer incidence in high-risk groups, the opposite of protection, and current heavy smokers had higher risk.

quotes.label: contradicts
quotes.quote: Retinyl palmitate combined with beta carotene increased risk of lung cancer in smokers in the large CARET trial.

quotes.quote: Importantly, CARET, the largest chemoprevention trial to date of vitamin A and lung cancers, found a significantly increased risk of lung cancers in the retinol and beta carotene arm [43].

quotes.label: contradicts
quotes.quote: The CARET trial found adverse effects on overall lung cancer risk among smokers and asbestos workers, and this seems to be supported by similar effects among current smokers in the trial by Lippman [43], [63].

quotes.label: supports
